newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria places 4.3 bln levs of 16-day T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria places 4.3 bln levs of 16-day T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Wednesday placed a special issue of 16-day floater coupon T-bills worth 4.266 billion levs, the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said.
The coupon was set equal to the BNB's central interest rate (CIR) for the period to maturity. The CIR is now set at a monthly 15 percent or 180 percent annually.
In line with its usual practice the BNB did not say with which financial institution or institutions the paper was placed.
But bank dealers said the ministry mignt have issued the T-bills to meet part of 1.44 billion levs maturity and interest payments on three-month discount T-bills due on Wednesday.
